name: Sumo Deadlift (Paused)
instructions: Set a wide stance with toes turned out and grip the bar inside your legs.
Brace your core and pull the slack out of the bar.
Lift the bar a couple of inches and pause for 1 to 2 seconds.
longevityNotes: Hip-hinge strength protects the lower back in every lift, from groceries to grandchildren. Strong glutes and hamstrings are the engine of walking, climbing, and standing up.
overview: A sumo deadlift with a pause just off the floor that builds position and strength at the start.
